scope: synthetic software diagnostic, not astronomical completeness or classification
baseline: maximum positive standardized residual after fitting a constant
endpoint: recovery and false alarms at separately calibrated 1-percent per-curve null threshold
development_note: Follow-up diagnostic designed after observing the IID-calibrated AR1 failure. New seed and separate calibration/test data; not independent external preregistration. Known covariance is supplied, not estimated from test curves.
